ai.privacy.body: Recto has no server. When you ask for AI help, your CV text (and the job description, if you pasted one) goes straight from this browser to the provider you choose here, and nowhere else. You confirm before the first request. AI only proposes changes; you accept or reject each one. Keys stay in this tab unless you tick “Remember on this device”, and are never written into your CV files or exports.
